limitations: Valid for independent Bernoulli variables sharing a common p in (0,1/3], nonnegative weights of total one, and at most six summands; not asserted for seven or more, unequal Bernoulli parameters, or strict-threshold events. An equivalent prior theorem could exist outside inspected sources.
scientific_integrity: Analytical inequality and equality classification; full proof included. A finite six-vertex graph lemma is exhaustively checked by the embedded standalone checker; no independent audit is claimed.
title: Sharp mean-crossing inequality for up to six weighted Bernoulli trials
